title: Tax break for affordable co-ops on Convent Avenue, Manhattan
summary: Resolution approving a 40-year real property tax exemption for four buildings at 48-50 Convent Avenue, 453-455 West 125th Street and 12-14 Old Broadway in Manhattan's Manhattanville neighborhood. The exemption supports renovation of the buildings into about 75 affordable cooperative housing units under HPD's Affordable Neighborhood Cooperative Program. It can be terminated if the property is not operated according to program and agreement requirements.
